release_notes: Build 60 makes the Autopilot Needs You home count and Manage task queue use the same underlying task planner, preventing the two totals from drifting apart.
Waiting Related Video and Instagram prerequisites now remain visible in the task queue, while publish or completion actions stay disabled until the prerequisite state is ready.
Packaging rescue and release-warning items are also represented in the unified queue when they contribute to the Needs You count.
A new Website page is added to the main Factburst navigation for managing the Cloudflare quiz catalogue without opening Advanced tools.
The Website page shows connection state, live and upcoming website quizzes, stored question totals, scheduled sync coverage, and scheduled quizzes missing from the website.
Website controls include Refresh, Sync scheduled, Resync selected, Open project, and Website settings, using the existing safe Cloudflare website publishing service.
